root: ^King Merlot: So the orcs of Thorum dare to camp at our very doorstep.
^ And this Drogo—this zealot consumed by madness—believes their fabled stone lies here, in the Slepbone region?
^General Alcino: That’s what your trembling scouts overheard before spiders sent them running.
^ Drogo’s convinced the Cold Fire Stone is close, yes. Madmen don’t need proof.
^King Merlot: Then if war is indeed at hand... I must ask, General...
^ Will you stand with us? Will you wield that dread power which all men fear?
^General Alcino: How many times must I suffer this question? Your father asked it. His father before him.
^ And his father’s father as well. The answer was no then, it is no now, and it shall be no for all the ages to come.
^ My power is bound, for the good of us all. Bound, and never to be unshackled.
^King Merlot: I expected as much. Yet hope lingers, even when hope is folly.
^General Alcino: Folly gives life its savor. And yet... lately, I have seen a shadow grow through the veil.
^ Help comes, though not by my hand.
^General Alcino: Tell me, though... do your think our elven allies know the truth of what sustains them? The price of their so-called longevity?
^King Merlot: Enough, General. Not another word. We are not alone anymore.
^General Alcino: Right. I'll return to my shack. Wars don't plan themselves, you know.
